frontend_api.evidence: InferenceConfig gains ivppml_misspecification_robust (default False), read by ivppmlhdfe and IVPPMLHDFE.fit; structured DataFrame specs take the dense path when it is set. No other signature or export change.
frontend_api.description: Public call signatures, exports, aliases, CLI/front-end validation and compatibility.

backend_compute.evidence: IV-PPML dense/structured IRLS iterate on y/mean(y) via ppml_iv.irls.in_outcome_units and drop the absolute |eta|>30 divergence bound (exploding-slope check kept). PPML standardize=False uses Standardization.outcome_only. New ppml_iv.vce.ivppml_ee_vcov (meat via ivppml_vcov, one extra K-column FE projection). overid_test moved to iv.moments.
backend_compute.description: Solver/compute/cache/backend contracts, numerical defaults and resource controls.

errors.evidence: No new error class. A singular estimating-equation Jacobian raises InferenceError code inference.singular_jacobian; the false IV-PPML DivergenceError on large-unit outcomes no longer occurs.
errors.description: Structured exception classes, codes, stages, suggestions and public error boundaries.

public_contract.evidence: Three approved InferenceConfig contract changes (config/exported schema, signature) against immutable 0.9.2; new immutable 0.9.3 snapshot.

skill.evidence: skills/econhdfe/references/configuration.md lists ivppml_misspecification_robust; empirical-research.md explains IV-PPML overidentification diagnostics and when to request estimating-equation SEs.

linked_modules.evidence: overid_test now lives in outcome-agnostic econhdfe.iv.moments and is consumed by linear_iv.estimators and ppml_iv.estimator (no linear_iv <-> ppml_iv import). Block IV-PPML IRLS shares in_outcome_units. Architecture map regenerated.
linked_modules.description: Cross-module imports, shared schemas, adapters, compatibility shims and downstream consumers.

results_reporting.evidence: IV-PPML diagnostics add overidentification {stat, df, pvalue} (Hansen J on Z' w0 (y-mu)) and misspecification_robust. Default params/SE differ from 0.9.2 by <=4.2e-13 at ordinary outcome scales; PPML default path bitwise unchanged.
results_reporting.description: Result fields, publication output, diagnostics metadata and serialization-facing schemas.

config_defaults.evidence: All defaults unchanged: ivppml_misspecification_robust=False keeps the ivppmlhdfe sandwich; PPML standardize default True unchanged.

tests_validation.evidence: New tests: IV-PPML outcome-unit invariance (fails on 0.9.2), PPML standardize=False invariance (fails on 0.9.2), EE SE vs independent stacked M-estimator oracle plus Hansen J vs orthogonalized Wald oracle. Full suite, native within tests. Verification scripts, 11-case dense root comparison and 400-replication MC in archive/econhdfe/v0.9.2/development/ivppml-outer-inference-20261029.
